specification.status: exploratory extension recorded before its rerun, after examining the v1 research; no independent confirmation
specification.primary_scope: all common eligible holding months through December 2022

robustness_checks.robust: Original inputs; clip training and test features to training-only 1st/99th percentiles in every fold; Ridge grid [1,10,100,1000]. No return-forecast cap.
robustness_checks.no_policy: Original inputs excluding the five policy-path fields; same dates, training minimum, tuning and allocator as baseline. Quantifies dependence on sparse policy history.
robustness_checks.clip_only: Training-fold 1st/99th percentile clipping with original Ridge grid [0.01,0.1,1,10,100].
robustness_checks.shrink_only: No input clipping; stronger Ridge grid [1,10,100,1000].
robustness_checks.supported_policy: Original Ridge grid and no clipping; a policy feature is disabled in each training/validation fold until it has 12 finite observed training values. The threshold is a fixed sensitivity setting, not a selected production rule.

diagnostics: additive feature contributions to each forecast
specification.interpretation: No production selection, significance claim, vintage reconstruction, new horizon search, or reserved-test evaluation. Existing surprise-by-ANFCI/GPR interactions remain included. Robustness settings will not be optimized against episode returns.
specification.timing_corrections: Every inner validation target must end by its validation decision date. Policy snapshots dated after the last trading-day cutoff are withheld in all variants.
specification.inspection_threshold: Absolute monthly forecasts above 20% are flagged, not clipped.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of monthly net-return differences versus baseline, conditional on the fitted continuous runs
bootstrap.statistic: mean monthly net-return difference; unadjusted percentile intervals, exploratory, no multiple-comparison correction and no model refitting

inference.episode_boundary_rule: Shift starts and ends independently. Evaluate only complete windows within the common development history. Never clip requests into the reserved test or reset holdings.
inference.leave_out: Exclude each named episode from the continuous development run without retraining; compound retained months only.
inference.credit_redundancy: Report ANFCI and credit-level/change correlations on common development dates, plus expanding past-only prediction of each credit feature from contemporaneous known ANFCI level/change; 24 prior feature rows minimum. Descriptive shared information, not causal or proof of redundancy.

deferred: final production freeze and reserved-period evaluation

periods.name: COVID shock

periods.name: COVID recovery
periods.description: May–December 2020 holding months. Tests participation in the recovery after the initial shock.

periods.name: Inflation / rate shock
periods.description: January–December 2022 holding months. Tests the model during the inflation and rate-shock environment.

sources.feature: Latest available spread level, percentage points

settings.trade_timing: Last-trading-day decision; enter next trading-day close and exit next rebalance close. Holding month names the entry month.

settings.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of monthly net-return differences versus baseline, conditional on the fitted continuous runs
settings.statistic: mean monthly net-return difference; unadjusted percentile intervals, exploratory, no multiple-comparison correction and no model refitting

credit_shared_information.interpretation: Descriptive associations in revised histories. Past-only ANFCI projection of credit conditions is not a test of causal redundancy or asset-return predictability; the credit-versus-baseline forecast and portfolio comparisons remain necessary.

excluding_2020.description: Compound retained months from the continuous run; skip 2020 without retraining or restarting holdings. Disconnected intervals, not a tradable uninterrupted path.

unit_audit.targets: Decimal total returns over entry-close to next rebalance-close; not percent points or annualized returns.
unit_audit.covariance: Monthly decimal calendar-close returns; no annualization before BL.
unit_audit.prior_and_posterior: Monthly decimal returns with tau 0.05 and risk aversion 2.5. No cash series is supplied: views are total returns, not cash-adjusted excess returns.
unit_audit.warning_threshold: Absolute forecast above 20% per holding month is flagged for inspection only; never clipped by this diagnostic.
unit_audit.vintages: Latest revised histories with assumed lags. These diagnostics do not reconstruct real-time vintages.
